까 kka. Tight throat, no air. 꽃 = flower, 까만 = black.
따 tta. 딸 = daughter, 똑바로 = straight.
빠 ppa. 빨리 = quickly, 아빠 = dad.
싸 ssa. 쌀 = rice, 있어요 = there is.
짜 jja. 짜다 = salty, 진짜 = really.
ㅗ + ㅏ. 과일 = fruit, 와요 = come.
ㅜ + ㅓ. 원 = won, 뭐 = what.
ㅗ + ㅣ. 회사 = company, 외국 = foreign country.
ㅜ + ㅣ. 귀 = ear, 위 = up / stomach.
Both sound like 'we'. 왜 = why, 웨딩 = wedding.
의사 = doctor (ui), 거의 = almost (i), 친구의 = friend's (e).
all sound like t at the end
옷 ot, 있다 itda, 꽃 kkot, 끝 kkeut, 낮 nat.
Only one sounds: 닭 dak (chicken), 값 gap (price), 읽다 ikda.
Only 7 sounds survive at the end of a syllable: k, n, t, l, m, p, ng. 옷 sounds like 'ot', 꽃 like 'kkot'.
살 (sal, flesh) vs 쌀 (ssal, rice). Tense = tighter throat, no air puff.
g · kk · k (k-row: plain, tense, aspirated)
가 ga / 까 kka / 카 ka. Aspirated = big puff of air; tense = none, tight.
d · tt · t (t-row: plain, tense, aspirated)
달 dal (moon) / 딸 ttal (daughter) / 탈 tal (mask).
b · pp · p (p-row: plain, tense, aspirated)
불 bul (fire) / 뿔 ppul (horn) / 풀 pul (grass).
j · jj · ch (ch-row: plain, tense, aspirated)
자다 jada (sleep) / 짜다 jjada (salty) / 차다 chada (cold).
A final consonant jumps to the next vowel: 한국어 → 한구거 (han-gu-geo), 음악 → 으막 (eu-mak).
머리 meori, 다리 dari. At the end: l sound, 물 mul.
강 gang, 사랑 sarang. Never 'n-g' separated.
ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ before ㄴ/ㅁ turn nasal: 감사합니다 → 감사함니다, 국물 → 궁물.
의사 ui-sa (doctor) at the start; 거의 geo-i; possessive 의 → 에 (친구의 → 친구에).
개 and 게 sound identical; context decides.
